title: build validate also reports what only a launch would reject: a worker without a budget, one listing a candidate subagent, one with a harness that has no adapter; a subagent-tier build needs none of them
source: intended: docs/decisions.md (build validate: a tolerant check of every build of every layer, one line per file, problem lines, one summary line)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-13, build validate). Besides the load rules, the command reports the launch rules: a worker or conductor must have a `budget` mapping (`budget must be a mapping with tokens and usd_list_cap`), a harness with an adapter (`harness "<h>" has no adapter`), and every subagent it lists must be approved (`subagent "<s>" is <status>, not approved`). Each file below is otherwise valid, so it is the only problem of its file. The subagent-tier candidate has no budget and no harness and is still ok (those fields are unused in that tier), and a candidate subagent is not an error by itself, only a worker that lists it. Exit 2, the summary counts the four extra files.

stdout.regex:
(?m)^invalid lists-candidate repo jitso/builds/lists-candidate\.yaml
  subagent "candidate-helper" is candidate, not approved$

(?m)^invalid no-budget repo jitso/builds/no-budget\.yaml
  budget must be a mapping with tokens and usd_list_cap$

(?m)^invalid odd-harness repo jitso/builds/odd-harness\.yaml
  harness "some-other-harness" has no adapter$
